payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all pairs of days (bitmask representation for each day's student set). Check if union covers all students and each day has ≥N/2 available students.
payload.rationale: The solution brute-forces over all 10 day pairs, using bitwise OR and popcount-equivalent size checks. This is a complete search where candidate sets are represented as bitmasks, fitting search_bitmask_enumeration.
